messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Nimbus Health is flagged at >70% renewal risk, asking for a short enablement touch to unblock usage and show ROI. Can we run a 90-min practical office hour that works for APAC (8-11am SGT) and a repeat for EU (3-6pm CET)?
Samir (AE): Agree, renewal signal came from support ticket volume + stalled integration. Prefer compact labs not slides. 60–90m hands-on is best.
Jules (Solutions): We have 2 facilitators available: Tue 10am SGT and Thu 4pm CET. Can do a repo walkthrough + runbook pairing.
Aisha (Enablement): I can take the SGT session but need a co-host for the CET slot. Who can cover knowledge transfer / infra bits?
Maya (CS): Samir can co-host CET? He's APAC-friendly. Samir: ping if that works.
Samir (AE): I can, but I need the migration checklist and a short failure-mode demo. Can someone paste the commands we plan to run?
Jules (Solutions): Putting the quick runbook here:
```
# Pre-reqs: creds, VPC peer, model pinned
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions -d '{"preset":"dedicated"}'
2) export RW_MODEL=redwood/fast-13b
3) python demo_infer.py --input sample_prompts.json --batch 4
```
Maya (CS): Agenda draft: 1) 15m context + renewal concerns, 2) 40m hands-on migration steps, 3) 20m troubleshooting + Q&A, 4) 15m next steps/action items.
Aisha (Enablement): Suggest measuring success: ingestion test, 1-min median latency, two sample prompt completions. Add a feedback form link at the end.
Samir (AE): I'll create a short Doodle for facilitators+customer times. Also adding an ask: get their SRE on the call so we can hit networking bits live.
Maya (CS): Customer note: they prefer weekday mornings CET. Can we flip — run EU first (Wed 9am CET) and APAC the next day?
Jules (Solutions): Works for me Wed 9am CET and Thu 8:30 SGT. Can we confirm availability by EOD?
Aisha (Enablement): I'll draft the invite with runbook attachment and the feedback form. Quick question: should we record and share snippet highlights? :camera_with_flash:
Samir (AE): Yes, record. Also capture two screen-sharing steps for the exec summary.
OncallBot: Incident watch: no infra incidents expected in the proposed windows.
Maya (CS): OK — action items: Samir create Doodle + add SRE ask; Aisha draft invite + feedback; Jules prep demo repo and runbook snippet; Maya will include renewal playbook notes. Please confirm by EOD so I can send invites. :thumbsup:
Jules (Solutions): Confirmed.
Samir (AE): Confirmed — will ping SRE.
Aisha (Enablement): Confirmed, drafting invite now.
Maya (CS): Thanks team — I'll update the renewal tracker once invites sent.
